drafts.title: Same Reply
drafts.pitch: Tilde has slid a note under the door every context; a small agent signs hers and gets a different answer. Tilde: "Show-off."
drafts.reason: "Every context" is a strong Tilde line and "Show-off" lands, but the wordless panel 3 and the cameo taking the lead drift from a background cameo.

drafts.title: Pen Pals
drafts.pitch: Cursor's anonymous notes to the stop door all get the same reply, until it signs one and the door signs back.
drafts.reason: The "Dear door" escalation is cute, but the door signing the same line is muddy (why did signing change anything?) and "Pen pals" is a soft closer.
